about.text: Schmand is cream soured with lactic acid bacteria with at least 20 % fat: thicker and richer than sour cream, leaner than crème fraîche, and, unlike them, it may be heated again after souring, which helps it keep. Further east the same thing is smetana.

sources.text: The photograph, its author and its licence, from its page.

how.text: Schmand, and smetana further east, is cream soured by lactococci, sometimes with thermophilic streptococci, into a thick, glossy cream: richer than sour cream, leaner than crème fraîche.
